_comment: Custom actions offered in Settings and via POST /api/actions/<id>. Root-owned, installed by the Nix flake. Built-in actions (settings-*, wifi-*, restart-airplay, redeploy, clean-reboot) live in code. exec is an argv with an absolute program path — never a shell string. Security updates are automatic (unattended-upgrades); run `sudo unattended-upgrade -v` by hand if needed.

actions.label: Reboot
actions.description: Restarts the box; settings and the stack are kept. Playback stops for about a minute.
